name: compact-adviser-opencode
description: compact-adviser for OpenCode and front ends over its server, such as OpenChamber.

scripts.build: bun build src/plugin.ts --outfile dist/compact-adviser.js --target bun --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --banner "// compact-adviser for OpenCode, built from github.com/jaylamping/compact-adviser (packages/opencode-plugin, branch desktop-attended). Rebuild: npm ci && npm run build, then copy dist/compact-adviser.js here. Settings: ~/.config/opencode/compact-adviser.json (see that package's README)."
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
